overview: A mobile-first PWA for learning the Aymara language from Spanish, with gamified lessons, vocabulary, games, XP, streaks and an identity inspired by Andean textiles.
features: Learn Aymara through interactive gamified lessons
Vertical learning path with progressive unit unlocking
Play educational games (Memoria Aymara, Empareja palabras)
Earn XP, level up and keep daily streaks
Guest mode with progress saved on device
Visual identity inspired by Andean textiles and culture
